title: Prime Minister expresses pride in Indian contingent’s performance at Commonwealth Games 2026
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister expresses pride in Indian contingent’s performance at Commonwealth Games 2026 प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 AUG 2026 9:55AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has expressed pride in the performance of the Indian contingent at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. The Prime Minister expressed delight that India won 39 medals, including 13 Gold medals, and congratulated all the medal winners. Shri Modi said that throughout the Games, the Indian athletes displayed exceptional skill, determination and dedication. He added that their hard work will continue to inspire the nation’s youth. Shri Modi also extended his best wishes to the entire Indian contingent for their future endeavours and expressed hope that they would continue to bring greater glory to the nation. Shri Modi wrote on X; “Proud of our contingent’s performance at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. Delighted that India has won 39 medals, including 13 Golds. Congrats to the medal winners. Throughout the Games, our talented athletes have displayed exceptional skill, determination and dedication. Their hardwork will keep inspiring our youngsters. My best wishes to the entire Indian contingent for the endeavours ahead. May they continue to give their very best and bring further glory to the nation. #CWG2026” Proud of our contingent’s performance at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of courage and perseverance
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of courage and perseverance प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 AUG 2026 9:51AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, said that one should never lose courage even when fortune turns unfavourable, for patience and perseverance can help a person regain lost ground. He noted that just as a skilled sailor whose ship breaks apart in the middle of the ocean does not lose hope but continues striving to survive by swimming, determination and steadfast effort enable one to overcome adversity. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “त्याज्यं न धैर्यं विधुरेऽपि दैवे धैर्यात्कदाचित्स्थितिमाप्नुयात्सः। याते समुद्रेऽपि च पोतभङ्गे सांयात्रिको वाञ्छति कर्म एव।। ” The Subhashitam conveys that one should not lose patience even when fortune is adverse, for through patience, one can always regain a lost favorable situation. Just as a skilled sailor, even when his ship breaks apart in the middle of the ocean, focuses solely on his actions, namely, the effort to survive and swim, without losing heart. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “त्याज्यं न धैर्यं विधुरेऽपि दैवे धैर्यात्कदाचित्स्थितिमाप्नुयात्सः। याते समुद्रेऽपि च पोतभङ्गे सांयात्रिको वाञ्छति कर्म एव ।।” त्याज्यं न धैर्यं विधुरेऽपि दैवे धैर्यात्कदाचित्स्थितिमाप्नुयात्सः। याते समुद्रेऽपि च पोतभङ्गे सांयात्रिको वाञ्छति कर्म एव ।। pic.twitter.com/m5PshMgvV6 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 3, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/ST (रिलीज़ आईडी: 2293568) आगंतुक पटल  : 233 इस विज्ञप्ति को इन भाषाओं में पढ़ें: Gujarati , Kannada , Malayalam Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of courage and perseverance प्रविष्टि तिथि:

title: From Skills to National Honour: Six DDU-GKY Youth Invited as Special Guests for India’s 80th Independence Day Celebrations
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Rural Development From Skills to National Honour: Six DDU-GKY Youth Invited as Special Guests for India’s 80th Independence Day Celebrations प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                03 AUG 2026 11:32AM by PIB Delhi In a significant recognition of the transformative impact of rural skill development, six beneficiaries of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY), representing West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Mizoram and Nagaland, have been invited as Special Guests for India’s 80th Independence Day celebrations in New Delhi on 15 August 2026. The selected beneficiaries have received their official invitation letters through India Post to attend the Independence Day ceremony at the Red Fort and the prestigious ‘At Home’ dinner reception hosted by the Hon’ble President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan. This honour is not only a recognition of their individual achievements, but also a national acknowledgement of the transformation enabled by DDU-GKY through skills, sustainable livelihoods and dignified employment. The youth will witness the national ceremony at the Red Fort and participate in the reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan. Their presence at these prestigious national events is a proud moment for the rural skilling ecosystem and for the young achievers who have emerged through DDU-GKY. DDU-GKY is the flagship placement-linked skill development programme under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) of the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. The programme equips rural poor youth with industry-relevant skills, nationally recognised certifications, and access to sustainable and dignified employment opportunities. Through DDU-GKY, lakhs of rural youth across the country have been connected with long-term livelihood opportunities. The programme has enabled them to become economically empowered, self-reliant and active contributors to India’s growth story. The invitation extended to these six beneficiaries is a national recognition of the scheme’s success in creating a skilled workforce and promoting sustainable livelihoods. It demonstrates that skill development goes beyond employment—it enables dignified careers, economic independence and a more secure future for rural youth. This achievement reflects the determination and hard work of the selected beneficiaries, as well as the collective efforts of the respective State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs), Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs), and the Ministry of Rural Development. The honour will inspire millions of rural youth across India and reinforce the vision that skills create opportunities, sustainable livelihoods build self-reliance, and empowered youth accelerate the journey towards a Viksit Bharat. *** RC/PU (रिलीज़ आईडी: 2293602) आगंतुक पटल  : 9 इस विज्ञप्ति को इन भाषाओं में पढ़ें: हिन्दी Ministry of Rural Development From Skills to National Honour: Six DDU-GKY Youth Invited as Special Guests for India’s 80th Independence Day Celebrations प्रविष्टि तिथि:
